### Candidate 1: stock_picking_invoice_link (OCA module, "Stock Picking Invoice Link")
Direct dependencies: stock_account
Documentation:
# Stock Picking Invoice Link

## SUMMARY
Adds link between pickings and invoices

## DESCRIPTION
The base module used by sale_stock_picking_invoice_link and purchase_stock_picking_invoice_link 
to adds a link between pickings and invoices as well as on the lines.

## USAGE
- Create a Sales Order and confirm.
- Deliver its pickings totally or partially.
- Create an invoice of the goods delivered.
- If you open invoice form, you must see a new Pickings tab with
  information about them.
Business functions (knowledge graph):
- Link stock pickings and invoices: Establishes a link between stock pickings and invoices at both the header and line levels, providing visibility of related pickings in a dedicated tab on the invoice.
Models (relation of the module to the model; fields the module adds):
- stock.picking (Transfer) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds invoice_count, invoice_ids
- stock.move (Stock Move) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds invoice_line_ids
- account.move (Journal Entry) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds picking_count, picking_ids
- account.move.line (Journal Item) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds move_line_ids
- account.move.reversal (Account Move Reversal) [EXTENDS]
- account.bank.statement.line (Bank Statement Line) [ADDS_FIELD, delegated: no code here]; adds picking_count, picking_ids
GitHub issues selected by the Collector agent (may describe older or newer versions):

I create Invoice from sales order partially (eq. 2), for eq. INV-0001 Then I release the DO partially using 2 quantity, with back order (WH/OUT/0001 as delivered and WH/OUT/0002 as available), INV-0001 is still linked into WH/OUT/0002. This is not the correct way I think. In WH/OUT/0002 there should be no INV-0001. CMIIW Thank you.
- #434 [11.0] stock_picking_invoice_link, picking link not removed when removing invoice line (issue, closed, 2018): When the invoice line of a related picking in an invoice is removed. The relation is not removed. Reproduce: 1. create invoice from sale order with multiple deliveries 2. check how many pickings are linked 3. Remove one the invoice lines 4. Same amount of pickings are linked
- #578 [11.0] stock_picking_invoice_link (issue, closed, 2019): When there are returns of delivery notes they do not appear in the list of delivery notes. If invoices with positive and negative quantities to avoid making credit invoices
- #780 [13.0] stock_picking_invoice_link not show all related invoices on picking (issue, closed, 2021): Steps to reproduce: 1-Make a sale of stockable product 2 und 2-Do the picking delivery for the 2 und 3-Sale order is up to invoice, but on invoice decrease qty and do 1 und invoice 4-Sale order is still up to invoice, then do the invoice for the remain 1 und 5-At this point we have 2 invoices on the same picking, go to the picking and click on invoices smart button 6-Only the first invoice form its shown Spected behaivor: a tree view with the 2 related invoices Ty
- #127 Feature request: stock_picking_invoice_link, Print the liste of pickings on invoices (issue, closed, 2015): In France (and probably elsewhere) it's now mandatory to print the delivery date of the goods on invoices. Since `stock_picking_invoice_link` adds the list of pickings on the invoice form, I suggest we extend stock_picking_invoice_link to print the picking references and delivery dates at the bottom of the invoices.
